equal_exposure_landmarks.note: landmark weight = share of the 200 E7 truncation draws in which the NP endoscopy is kept

definitions.landmark: every pre-event endoscopy (288), scored with the patient's history up to and including it (memory is causal: audit task)
definitions.positive at horizon h: progressor endoscopy with years to the event <= h (ever: every progressor endoscopy)
definitions.negative at horizon h: non-progressor endoscopy with known event-free follow-up >= h (to the last sequenced endoscopy, extended by later Barrett's database records), or progressor endoscopy with years to the event > h
definitions.weights: patient-bootstrap multiplicities (2,000 draws, RandomState(0)); patient_weighted = each patient's landmarks share weight 1
definitions.auroc_margin: landmark AUROC of the held-out score minus its fold threshold (pooled over folds), repeat mean; memory vs the same base without memory, each with the round-9 training threshold rule
